'''''MedStar II: Jedi Healer''''' is the second novel of the [[MedStar Duology]], written by [[Michael Reaves]] and [[Steve Perry]] and published by [[Del Rey]] on [[September 28]], [[2004]]. Starting approximately one week after ''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]'', this novel continues the story of [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]], [[Jos Vondar]], [[Tolk le Trene]], [[Klo Merit]], [[I-5YQ]], [[Den Dhur]] and [[Kaird]] the [[Nediji]] during their stay on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]] over the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]]' war for [[Bota/Legends|bota]] over the planet. An [[MedStar II: Jedi Healer (abridged audiobook)|abridged audiobook adaption]] narrated by [[Jonathan Davis]] was released the same day.
